title: Interpreting parts of an expression in context
keyIdea: In a formula that models a situation, each term, factor and coefficient has a meaning. Read 3 + 1.5m as flag fall plus rate per mile; read P(1 + r)ⁿ with P as start and (1 + r) as the growth factor treated as one quantity.
familyTip: Show a taxi fare 3 + 1.5m and ask what the 3 and the 1.5 mean in real life before anyone calculates a number.

visual.caption: Meaning or mix-up? Drag each claim, or tap it then a box.

items: P is the growth factor in P(1+r)ⁿ
a bracket can be one quantity
every number in a formula is a rate

lab.caption: Flagship lab: map taxi parts, mark growth factor, treat a bracket as one quantity, spot the rate coefficient, catch mix-ups, then challenge.

kid: A formula is more than numbers to crunch. Each part can stand for something real: a starting charge, a rate, a growth factor, or a count of periods.
In 3 + 1.5m, the 3 is a fixed flag-fall and 1.5 is pounds for each mile. In P(1 + r)ⁿ, P is the start and (1 + r) is the growth factor for each period.
Sometimes a bracket is one quantity. In 2(x + 5), the factor (x + 5) is a single lump multiplied by 2.
Ask which part controls the rate of change. In 20 + 4h, the coefficient 4 is the hourly rate.
adult: Ages 14 to 16. CCSS A-SSE.1: interpret terms, factors and coefficients in context; view complicated parts as single quantities. Not the rewrite-equivalent-forms lesson.
Words: term, factor, coefficient, growth factor, flag fall, rate. Common mistakes: calling every number a rate; saying P is the growth factor; splitting a bracket that should stay one quantity.
In the lab the learner maps taxi and compound-growth parts, treats a bracket as one factor, marks the rate coefficient, and spots mix-ups.

practice.explain: 1.5 is the coefficient of m — the rate in pounds per mile. The 3 is the fixed start.

practice.prompt: In P(1 + r)ⁿ the growth factor is…
practice.hint: Which part multiplies the amount each period?
practice.explain: (1 + r) is the growth factor. P is the starting amount; n counts periods.

practice.hint: The fixed term is the flag fall.
practice.explain: The constant term {a} is the flag-fall charge in pounds.

practice.hint: A-SSE.1b: complicated parts as single quantities.
practice.explain: Treat (x + 5) as one factor multiplied by 2.

practice.hint: The coefficient of h is pounds per hour.
practice.explain: The coefficient {b} is the hourly rate.

choices: P is the growth factor in P(1+r)ⁿ
pool.hint: Who starts the amount, and who grows it?
pool.explain: P is the start. The growth factor is (1 + r).

choices: the number multiplying a variable or factor
pool.hint: Think of the 4 in 4h. Read each part against the real situation before calculating.
pool.explain: A coefficient multiplies a variable or factor; it is not the letter and not automatically the total.

pool.prompt: Fare = {a} + 1.5m for {b} miles. Flag fall still?
pool.hint: Flag fall does not change with miles.
pool.explain: Flag fall stays {a} pounds even when miles are {b}.

pool.prompt: Best first step when reading a formula is…
pool.explain: Start from the real situation, then map each part.

pool.prompt: In Cost = 20 + 4h, what sets how fast cost grows with h?
choices: the letter h with no number
pool.hint: Which part is the rate? Read each part against the real situation before calculating.
pool.explain: Changing 4 changes the hourly rate. The 20 is a fixed start.

pool.prompt: Growth factor each year is 1.0{a}. As a percent increase?
This lesson vs rewriting expressions is mainly about…
choices: what each part means in a real situation
pool.hint: Interpretation in context, not rewrite drills.
pool.explain: A-SSE.1 focuses on meaning of terms, factors and coefficients in context.

pool.prompt: Treating (1 + r) as one quantity means…
choices: the whole bracket is the growth factor
you must split 1 and r into two bills
pool.explain: (1 + r) stays together as the growth factor each period.

pool.prompt: Standing charge {a} plus {b} per unit. Coefficient of units?
pool.hint: Which number multiplies the unit count?
pool.explain: The per-unit rate {b} is the coefficient.
